long_description:
Locke builds AI agents that help companies and governments work together.

Our agents power Locke Government Affairs, the first AI-native government affairs firm, and are being deployed to government agencies across America.

Every consequential American company in the 21st century will need to work with the government: AI labs, data centers, healthcare, defense, robotics, the list goes on. Locke is building the AI infrastructure to power the next era of public-private collaboration.

Locke's team comes from The White House, Deloitte, the US Congress, and the Pentagon.
